description: Périmètres (2km) autour des gares de la région Île-de-France localisés sur la CDGT du Sdrif approuvé par décret le 27 décembre 2013 is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. [Situation 2013] Repère approximatif d'aide à la localisation des droits d'extension non cartographiés liés aux secteurs en développement à proximité des gares (se référer au fascicule Orientations règlementaires et carte de destination générale des différentes parties du territoire 27 décembre 2013). Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Aménagement, Planification. The portal shows 54 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
